summary: Changelogs are generated from fragments added with feature and bug-fix changes (not needed for new modules or plugins); antsibull-changelog is recommended for collections.
questions: Do I need a changelog fragment for a new module?
What tool should I use for changelog fragments in a collection?

answer_card.title: Changelog fragments
answer_card.answer_md:
Changelogs are built from **fragments**. Add one when adding features to existing modules/plugins or fixing bugs. New modules and plugins do **not** need one; their entries come from their documentation.

For collections, use **antsibull-changelog**. For ansible-core, follow the changelog examples in the Community Guide.
